hook.description: Low-angle shot of flames crackling beneath a bedroom door.
hook.evidence: The immediate visual of a fire trapping someone in their bedroom creates instant high-stakes tension.

candidates.reason: The intense rescue sequence establishes the immediate danger and the bond between the leads.

hook.description: Ceiling beams splitting and roaring with fire.
hook.evidence: The visual of a collapsing ceiling provides a visceral, life-or-death hook.

candidates.reason: This segment captures the desperate struggle to save a precious item while the house collapses around them.

hook.description: Juliana kneeling in the mud, soot-covered, clutching a charred ledger.
hook.evidence: The emotional aftermath of the fire and the visual of the destroyed home immediately grounds the viewer in the tragedy.

candidates.reason: The transition from grief to Alexander's vow of vengeance provides a powerful narrative arc for a promo.
